npcs.name: Geneva Clerkglass
npcs.description: Geneva Clerkglass is a polished Giff city clerk whose manners are so controlled that people forget she decides who reaches the desk, the door, the warrant, and the mayor. At the Zarveng Guild Desk, she manages appointments, sealed correspondence, civic filings, and the small procedural delays that can save a life or ruin one. She is not openly cruel, but she is deeply institutional: if the truth threatens the city’s stability, Geneva will first ask whether the truth has filed the proper form.
npcs.settlementAndAncestryTexture: Zarveng is a Town in Kharvathen, under Oligarchy, with moderate danger, Farming, Partial forest, Deep forest terrain. Local records favor Altruistic, Lawful, Cooperative, Honorable civic habits; common communities include Human, Halfling — Lightfoot Halfling, Halfling — Stout Halfling, Kender, Kithkin. Giff reads through the Giff entry of the race compendium, within Animalfolk and Mammalian Anthropomorphs, marked by Iskareth. Giff are stout, hippo-like humanoids with a fascination for firearms and disciplined martial structure. They are known for combining military precision with cultural rigidity and humor. Table cues: Astral Spark, Firearms Mastery, Hippo Build; starting tendency Neutral - Lawful - Neutral - Honorable.
rumors: Geneva Clerkglass knows why an ichor ledger changed hands last Enkirday.
Geneva Clerkglass has a contact in Thal'véra who will deny everything.
plotHooks: Geneva Clerkglass asks the party to protect a household member without revealing why.
